fallback: Even on the days I forget to write, I don't forget you.
_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. If today has no entry, the most recent past one keeps showing. Order doesn't matter. Keep the commas correct — no comma after the last entry.

messages.text: Good morning. I made you a place to find me every day.
You were the first thing I thought about today.
Whatever today throws at you — I'm on your side.
